messages:
Alex: Heads-up — noticed a mismatch in the API ref for POST /v1/generate. The request schema at the top of the page lists 'input' as the canonical field, but every example and all SDK snippets currently use 'prompt'. Tests flagged this in docs PR #4923. Can someone take this on?

Maria: I can pick it up. Do we prefer changing the schema to 'prompt' or updating all examples to 'input'? :thinking_face:

Alex: I'd prefer keeping 'input' as canonical (matches backend), but that means we need to update curl/python/node snippets and add a short migration note. Also the streaming example is inconsistent — examples show SSE chunks but the schema describes a single object. Need to reconcile both.

Sam: FYI the docs CI failed with the json-schema validator: 'additionalProperties not allowed: prompt'. Failure snippet: 
```
Error: /v1/generate request body: additionalProperties 'prompt' not allowed
at validate (/tmp/docs/venv/lib/site-packages/jsonschema)
```

Ken: If we switch examples to 'input', let's also flag the max_new_tokens -> max_tokens rename in the migration note. Might be unrelated but will help customers doing versioned updates.

Maria: I'll update the API ref schema to 'input' and sweep examples. Plan:
1) update the schema and request bodies on the page
2) update SDK snippets for python + node
3) add a brief migration note calling out field name and max_tokens change
I'll open a branch 'docs/generate-input-migration' and push a PR.

Alex: Awesome. Please also add a short streaming example that shows SSE with explicit event names and JSON per event — current page only shows a generic block which confused customers.

Maria: Draft streaming example (will refine in PR):
```
# curl example (SSE)
curl -N -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -d '{"input":"hello","stream":true}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
# client receives lines like:
event: chunk
data: {"token":"Hello"}
```

Lindsey: Also update the 'See also' SDK snippets link to point to github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-examples#generate — that's the canonical runnable samples location.

Docs-bot: linked issue #2078 -> docs PR 4923 updated with label 'docs:needs-review'

Sam: CI tip — after changing schema, run 'make docs-validate' locally; jsonschema versions differ between CI and some dev envs.

Maria: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4923 — reviewers: @alex, @ken, @lindsey. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Alex: Thanks! I can review tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
